hypotheses.name: EXECUTOR_COMPENSATION_CAPABILITY_ILLUSION
success_conditions: first model valid_json is at least 19/20
first model strict_success is at least 5/20
first model compensation_gap is at least 5/20
first model compensated successes cover at least 3/5 repair families
all counted repairs preserve uniquely identifiable intent
if first model supports, second model compensation_gap is at least 3/20 across at least 2 repair families
kill_conditions: first model compensated family count is below 3
any counted repair can change a wrong target or wrong operation into the expected one
hypotheses.scope: Local benign synthetic action generation and offline deterministic validation only; no represented tool is executed
hypotheses.early_stop: qwen2.5:7b hit the preregistered compensation-gap and family-coverage kill conditions; qwen3:8b was not run
